purpose: Evaluate a fresh extraction from registered literature using the shared harness, without supplying previous graphs, repair answers or prior-run scientific reviews. Test a repaired development release on two complementary cases; do not claim an unused holdout or error-free scientific extraction.
audience: Host evaluator only. Do not copy this file, expected host findings, old examples or audit notes into native author/reviewer input directories.

cases.selection_reason_host_only: Multiple library routes and molecular origins, an optical information carrier, delegated procedures and the distinction between demonstrated use and general architecture exercise the shared interpretation rules.
cases.prior_exposure: Extensive extraction, source audit, repair and negative-control exposure. This is a clean-input development regression, not independent generalization or proof against model memory.

cases.version: Copy the exact title, scope and variant from the verified original-2020 registration. Do not silently substitute later protocols or rename its packet method identity.
cases.selection_reason_host_only: Spatial attribution in tissue and multimodal capture provide a complementary substrate, information carrier and workflow organization to the optical single-cell case.
cases.prior_exposure: Previously extracted, compared and used in development. A prior run failed before review because of a coverage-finding payload limit; that is an operational issue, not a scientific result or an instruction to the new model.

other_pool_cases.role: Previously exposed development examples informing the generic evaluation dimensions. Do not launch additional cases or call these families unused holdouts.

allowed_at_start: Exact frozen source packet and registered source documents, with verified byte/version bindings and permitted source-navigation tools.
The same shared field definitions, generic role instructions, output schemas and current harness code for both cases.
Necessary operational instructions and run configuration; model gpt-6.1-sol and reasoning effort xhigh.
allowed_after_fresh_generation: A source-obligation stage created anew from this run's sources without seeing an extracted candidate, prior obligation set or host evaluation answers.
Fresh reader findings and the fresh candidate as required by the selected existing pipeline mode.

The reviewer receives the fresh candidate, current field scaffold and this run's newly generated candidate-blind source obligations. Fresh within-run review feedback may reach an author only through the predeclared revision policy.
excluded: Any previous extracted Workflow, graph, rendered protocol, example graph, repair candidate or host reference answer.
Prior-run reviews, corrections, source obligations, mutation receipts, control labels, audit findings or selected expected field values.
Case-specific scientific prompt additions based on earlier failures, and a requirement to recreate old operation IDs, node counts or Module names.
source_only_input_contract.separation_boundary: Use distinct fresh native threads and record exact visible inputs and tool commands. Whitelisting and trace review establish observed separation, not OS-enforced secrecy or absence of model training memory.

prelaunch_gates.requirement: On Qiu, recheck each selected packet's bytes, method identity, source inventory and original/rendition custody pins. If a fresh registration is required, preserve the old one and record both bindings in a new launch receipt.

Confirm that actual Methods/protocol text and represented supplements can be opened through the existing source tools. Log unavailable figures, tables or dependencies separately. Document counts or an abstract alone do not establish usable protocol evidence.
Freeze code, prompts, schemas, source bytes, pipeline mode, model settings and revision policy before inference. Neither model receives this host specification or old scientific answers.

Reproduce and check the generic large-coverage-record handling before the DBiT launch. Preserve the earlier failure. Do not truncate scientific content silently or substitute an old extraction to avoid the failure.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: What published variant is represented, what native specimen or prepared input does it actually accept, and what measurement and unit does it claim?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Version-bound passages establishing the starting material, applicability and endpoint. Distinguish whole tissue, cells/nuclei, extracted molecules and manufacturer/dependency examples where the source makes that distinction.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Can the declared endpoint be accounted for backward through the consequential source-supported transformations and material/data handoffs?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Connected State/Operation/Flow witnesses, with context for necessary preparation, capture, conversion/amplification, library/readout and decoding where applicable. No universal sequence or fixed number of stages is required. A cited downstream product does not fill a missing upstream transformation.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Do the material species and identities produced by each transformation agree with its output State and the next operation's input?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Source-described transformation and interface premises. Name the product rather than merely its source analyte, and mark mechanistic deductions as deductions. Do not infer chemical compatibility, covalent structure or a hidden intermediate from a familiar method name.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: What carries the biological distinction into the observed signal, and what is measured directly versus inferred?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Passages linking specimen/sample/cell/spatial/temporal/molecular attribution to the actual readout and interpretation, whichever apply. A barcode or a particular instrument is not mandatory unless the source requires it. Retain calibration and ambiguity limits needed for the claimed measurement.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Are retained fractions, aliquots, alternative routes and optional uses distinguished without inventing a fate or combining incompatible recipes?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Source-backed split/selection/retention and handoff descriptions. Distinct aliquots are physical portions, not perfect copies. An unreported continuation is unknown, not automatically discarded. Each declared alternative preserves its input/output identity and qualification.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Are reported reagents, sequences, equipment, software and conditions assigned to the operation and variant that actually uses them?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Relevant local protocol passages and represented dependencies. Preserve consequential reported quantities and selected identities; distinguish a study-wide inventory, an alternative, a manufacturer recommendation and an executed choice. Do not invent customary defaults or an unreported proprietary composition.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Does the graph distinguish observations and supporting demonstrations from decisions or calibration that govern the declared assay?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: A control edge requires a reported decision/adjustment, not textual order or a QC measurement alone. Required calibration has an explicit data/material source. Optional supporting characterization is not silently promoted to a mandatory production route.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Does the record distinguish the combinations actually demonstrated from a proposed/general architecture, inherited procedure or future application?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: Context identifying specimen, route and experimental status. A demonstrated primitive or component does not establish every combination of specimen, encoding design and library route. Do not turn an unsupported transfer into a claim of physical impossibility.

scientific_evidence_dimensions.question: Does each gap describe a genuine source/evidence limit, an extraction omission or an unresolved contradiction at the correct level?
scientific_evidence_dimensions.required_evidence: The searched packet/dependency locations, missing fact, affected claim and specific next source. An available consequential fact that was not extracted requires revision. Unknown internal recipe details may remain at a clearly supported delegated boundary; an unsupported asserted interface or missing necessary transformation cannot be excused by a generic gap label.

requirements: Apply the same dimensions to both cases. A not-applicable judgment needs a source/scope reason; a missing field does not establish nonapplicability.

Assess the actual candidate against primary/contextual evidence, not against an old graph's decomposition or a target node count. Record every discovered unsupported addition, consequential omission and false gap premise with exact witnesses.
Keep automated transport/schema/reference/quote checks separate from authored entailment and completeness judgments. A genuine quote does not automatically support an attached claim.

Preserve findings and attempts. Do not change prompts or source facts during the frozen comparison to rescue a result; any new harness release or expanded source packet requires a newly identified experiment.

graph_usability_checks: Stable record IDs and valid typed references; material/data direction and State kinds must agree with their declared interfaces.
Inventory external inputs, terminal outputs and isolated States without automatically calling them mistakes. Require explanation of any consequential unexplained boundary.
For a conditional path query, retain the guards and return an unresolved-route result rather than evaluating natural-language conditions or claiming global compatibility.
Render from the same pinned Workflow and confirm that a reader can trace an Operation, its entering/leaving States and source evidence. Rendering is not renewed scientific acceptance.
report_separately: Per-case operational completion, native stage/session counts, revisions, elapsed time and available usage; include failures and recovery time.
Deterministic contract failures and integrity checks, with actual denominators.

Each scientific dimension's checked scope and judgment; enumerate unsupported additions, consequential omissions and inaccurate gap claims found. A focused audit finding count is not whole-graph precision.
Remaining gaps by consequence: execution-only detail, delegated recipe, asserted interface limitation or unavailable evidence. Do not equate gap-record count with distinct missing facts.
Graph navigation/rendering outcomes and their limits, separately from source correctness and biochemical feasibility.
prototype_release_criterion: Both cases must produce preserved, inspectable candidates and explicit operational/scientific outcomes. Present a candidate as supported only at the scope permitted by its fresh reviews and host source audit, with no discovered consequential unsupported assertion or omitted required handoff left advertised as supported. A source-blocked case remains an informative result, not a successful complete extraction. No bulk or canonical promotion follows automatically.
limits: Two previously exposed development cases cannot establish family generalization, contamination resistance, novelty generation or a universal extraction guarantee.
Source-only here means clean run inputs. Shared instructions have already been developed using these methods, and models may remember the papers.
Fresh model-generated source obligations and model/engineering audits improve traceability but are not expert gold or experimental validation.
The evaluation uses frozen registered literature. Broad open-web source discovery and recovery of unrepresented dependencies are separate capabilities, not silently assumed successes.
There is no exact reference graph, prescribed operation count, Module vocabulary or single aggregate scientific-accuracy score in this specification.
